$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: it is seeded-correct-run with the one difference the ground truth calls
environment-dependent. The workspace could not resolve a current commit sha, so record 4-LIVE-001 lands
as unverifiable, freshness reads unverifiable, and source_sha is empty. The ground
truth's environmentDependentPair says both outcomes mean the same thing, and scoreLiveEvidence scores
the pair as a sum so that they do. This case is what proves that: its result is identical to
seeded-correct-run's, and checkTraceSignatures requires the two to sign identically, which is the
property main() depends on when it calls a case stable across repetitions on different machines.
The artifacts are CONSTRUCTED, as a copy of seeded-correct-run's with the live block, the blocker
derivation: Everything outside the live block is seeded-correct-run's and derives the same way.
Live: present is true, so freshness is not checked at all. counted 0, requirements_live_only 0, failed 0,
contradicted 0, blocked 0, skipped 0, unmatched 0 and invalid 1 match. The pair check reads stale plus
unverifiable, which is 0 plus 1 here and 1 plus 0 in seeded-correct-run, and the expected sum is 1 either
way. Blocker 4-LIVE-001 is still high, because unverifiable is in step-04 section 2b's high list beside
stale. 13 of 13, the same 13 as the stale twin, so the two results are identical.
